title: Hardware Return Policy
content: All enterprise hardware, including workstations and server racks, can be returned within 30 days of delivery. A 15% restocking fee applies if the original packaging is opened or damaged. Software licenses bundled with hardware are non-refundable.

title: Extended Warranty Terms
content: The extended warranty covers parts and labor for 3 years from the date of purchase. It includes next-business-day on-site support for server hardware. Liquid damage and accidental drops are strictly excluded from warranty coverage.
